correctness.rationale: For a nonsingular symmetric 4x4 coefficient matrix over the field of three elements, the gradient is \(Ax^{(3)}\), so the quartic is smooth. Classification of 4-dimensional nondegenerate the field of three elements quadratic forms reduces all models to two forms. The line criterion is equivalent to a totally singular quadratic two-plane, proving 8 versus 0 rational lines. All geometric lines lie over F9 and 112 of the 7462 candidate two-planes are Hermitian-isotropic; a 22-line Gram minor has exact determinant -9, equal to the established geometric NS discriminant. Twisted Frobenius permutes these lines with order two. A unimodular-integer reduction computes the primitive integral kernels of the induced 22x22 matrices, yielding ranks 12/11, discriminants -3072/+6144, and Smith groups (Z/2)^9 + Z/6 versus (Z/2)^10 + Z/6. The complete verifier executed on the delivered source and also checked counts 16/10 rational points and 16/20 meeting conjugate-line pairs. No finite experiment is used as an unproved infinite statement. The orbit-sum classes span each primitive invariant lattice with Hermite normal form determinant 1; this verifies integral generation by rational line classes and conjugate-line traces.

originality.rationale: The general geometric Hermitian 112-line count and rank-22 Artin-one Neron-Severi lattice are attributed to Kondō–Shimada and Rams–Schütt; the standard-model Frobenius matrix is also explicitly attributed. The newly assessed claim classifies the entire invertible symmetric-Frobenius family over F3 by two arithmetic integral Picard lattices and line Galois incidence, in particular providing the nonsplit determinant +6144 and integral discriminant group. Neither inspected full primary paper states this complete arithmetic two-class result. The standard automorphism matrices permit computational deductions but do not directly report the nonsplit primitive invariant-lattice arithmetic; residual risk of an equivalent specialized Hermitian-descent table remains. The primitive-index-one integral generation by line orbit traces is part of the new arithmetic classification.
residual_risks: Kondō–Shimada provides a full automorphism representation; the new nonsplit numerical result might be a corollary of unperformed arithmetic twist calculations in another work.
Unindexed tables of Frobenius-fixed Neron-Severi lattices of unitary quartic forms could give an equivalent result in alternate coordinates.

value.rationale: The full open family of nondegenerate symmetric Frobenius coefficient matrices forms a natural finite-field Hermitian surface class, and its complete arithmetic division is geometrically meaningful. Different determinant classes have identical 112 geometric lines but different F3 rational-line existence, conjugate-line meeting configurations, and, more finely, nonisomorphic integral arithmetic Picard lattices and discriminant groups. Computed discriminant 6144 is an exact natural invariant that is not supplied by the 112-line count or rational eigenspace dimension, and is relevant to divisor arithmetic and descent. The index-one trace-generation theorem supplies explicit rational divisor generators, even in the nonsplit case with no rational lines.
